sections.title: Taxes and charges in Malta: complete list

rows.label: Capital gains: final tax on transfers of Malta immovable property (Taxxa fuq it-trasferiment ta' proprjetà immobbli) [national]
rows.value: 8% of the transfer value (10% for some group transfers of property acquired before 2004; 12% of the gain on property inherited or donated more than five years earlier). Paid by the seller. Income Tax Act (Cap. 123) art. 5A.
rows.note: Checklist item A5; detailed table: capital-gains

source.title: Income Tax Act (Cap. 123), consolidated text as amended up to Act III of 2026 (legislation.mt)

rows.label: Withholding on dividends, interest and other investment income (Taxxa finali fuq id-dħul minn investimenti) [national]
rows.value: 15% final tax on investment income such as interest where the recipient opts for it; 15% on dividends paid out of the untaxed account; dividends out of taxed profits carry the company's 35% tax (imputation). Paid by recipients (withheld by the paying company or financial intermediary). Income Tax Act (Cap. 123) art. 41 and 62.
rows.note: Checklist item A6; detailed table: distributed-profits

source.title: Income Tax Act (Cap. 123), consolidated text as amended up to Act III of 2026 (legislation.mt)

rows.label: Rental income and pension income (Dħul minn kera u pensjonijiet) [national]
rows.value: landlords may opt for a final tax of 15% on gross rental income (Income Tax Act art. 31D; form TA24); qualifying pension income of individuals aged 61 or over exempt from 2026. Paid by landlords and pensioners. Income Tax Act (Cap. 123); Rental income rules.
rows.note: Checklist item A7

source.title: MTCA: Tax on Rental Income (TA24)

rows.label: Employer levies: Maternity Leave Fund (Fond għall-Leave tal-Maternità) [national]
rows.value: 0.3% of the basic weekly wage (category C; fixed weekly amounts in the other categories). Paid by employers. Social Security Act (Cap. 318).
rows.note: Checklist item B2; detailed table: social-employer

source.title: Department of Social Security: Social Security Contributions (Class 1) 2026 – Employed Persons (Maternity Leave Fund column)

rows.label: Contractor rules: Employment Status National Standard (employee or self-employed test) (Standard Nazzjonali dwar l-Istatus tal-Impjieg) [national]
rows.value: employment presumed where at least five of eight criteria are met (e.g. 75% of income from one client, client's tools, working schedule, no substitution). Paid by service users (employer obligations where the presumption applies). Employment Status National Standard Order (S.L. 452.108).
rows.note: Checklist item B3b; detailed table: contractor-rules

source.title: Employment Status National Standard Order (S.L. 452.108, Legal Notice 44 of 2012 as amended) (legislation.mt)

rows.label: Corporate income tax (Taxxa fuq il-kumpaniji) [national]
rows.value: 35% with shareholder refunds of part or all of the tax on distribution (imputation system). Paid by companies resident in Malta (worldwide income) and foreign companies on income arising in Malta. Income Tax Act (Cap. 123) art. 56(6).
rows.note: Checklist item C1; detailed table: corporate-tax

source.title: Malta Tax and Customs Administration (MTCA): Corporate Tax

rows.label: Simplified regime: 10% final tax on part-time self-employment (Taxxa ta' 10% fuq xogħol part-time għal rasu) [national]
rows.value: 10% of net profit up to €12,000 a year (maximum €1,200); VAT small-enterprise exemption in the VAT section. Paid by full-time employees, pensioners and full-time students with part-time self-employment. Income Tax Act (Cap. 123) and the part-time self-employment rules.
rows.note: Checklist item C3; detailed table: freelancers

source.title: MTCA: Self-Employed (TA22), part-time self-employment

rows.label: Tax on distributed profits: imputation and the untaxed account (Taxxa fuq dividendi) [national]
rows.value: no branch profits tax; 15% withheld on dividends paid out of the untaxed account. Paid by companies distributing untaxed profits (withheld from the dividend). Income Tax Act (Cap. 123) art. 62.
rows.note: Checklist item C4; detailed table: distributed-profits

source.title: Income Tax Act (Cap. 123), consolidated text as amended up to Act III of 2026 (legislation.mt)

rows.label: Value added tax (Taxxa fuq il-Valur Miżjud (VAT)) [national]
rows.value: 18% standard (also on imports); 12%, 7% and 5% for supplies in the Eighth Schedule. Paid by consumers (charged by registered businesses). Value Added Tax Act (Cap. 406) art. 19 and Eighth Schedule.
rows.note: Checklist item D1; detailed table: vat-rates

source.title: Value Added Tax Act (Cap. 406), article 19 and Eighth Schedule (legislation.mt)

rows.label: Excise duties on fuel, alcohol, tobacco and other goods (Dazju tas-sisa) [national]
rows.value: e.g. unleaded petrol €359 and gas oil €330 per 1,000 litres; cigarettes 23.4% of retail price plus €107 per 1,000 (minimum €165). Paid by producers, importers and authorised warehouse keepers (passed on to consumers). Excise Duty Act (Cap. 382) First Schedule.
rows.note: Checklist item D3; detailed table: excise

source.title: Excise Duty Act (Cap. 382), First Schedule, as amended up to Act III of 2026 and Legal Notice 38 of 2026 (legislation.mt)

rows.label: Duty on insurance policies (insurance premium duty) (Taxxa fuq polza tal-assigurazzjoni) [national]
rows.value: 11 cents per euro of the yearly premium on most policies (minimum €13); 10 cents per euro on life policies (minimum €11.65); none on aviation, marine, credit and suretyship policies. Paid by policyholders (collected by insurers). Duty on Documents and Transfers Act (Cap. 364) art. 25A and 27.
rows.note: Checklist item D4; detailed table: stamp-duties

source.title: Duty on Documents and Transfers Act (Cap. 364), consolidated text as amended up to Act XXX of 2025 (legislation.mt)

rows.label: Property transfer duty (duty on documents and transfers) (Taxxa tal-boll fuq trasferimenti ta' proprjetà) [national]
rows.value: 5% of the price or value, whichever is higher; 3.5% on the first €200,000 for a sole ordinary residence; 1% provisional duty on the promise of sale. Paid by the buyer. Duty on Documents and Transfers Act (Cap. 364) art. 32.
rows.note: Checklist item E2; detailed table: stamp-duty-property

source.title: Duty on Documents and Transfers Act (Cap. 364), consolidated text as amended up to Act XXX of 2025 (legislation.mt)

rows.label: Duty on inheritance of immovable property (causa mortis) (Taxxa causa mortis) [national]
rows.value: 5% of the value (3.5% on the first €150,000 where the heir lives in the property); surviving spouse's share of the residence and children inheriting the parents' residence exempt. Paid by heirs of immovable property in Malta. Duty on Documents and Transfers Act (Cap. 364) art. 32 to 35.
rows.note: Checklist item E4; detailed table: inheritance

source.title: MTCA: FAQs Causa Mortis

rows.label: Motor vehicle registration tax and annual circulation fee (Taxxa tar-reġistrazzjoni u liċenzja annwali tal-vetturi) [national]
rows.value: registration tax and annual circulation licence fee by vehicle category, CO2 emissions and value (amounts not stored). Paid by vehicle owners. Motor Vehicles Registration and Licensing Act (Cap. 368) First and Fourth Schedules.
rows.note: Checklist item F1

source.title: Motor Vehicles Registration and Licensing Act (Cap. 368), as amended up to Act III of 2026 (legislation.mt)

rows.label: Eco-contribution on tourist accommodation (Eko-kontribuzzjoni fuq l-akkomodazzjoni) [national]
rows.value: €1.50 per night per person, at most €22.50 per visit. Paid by guests aged 18 or over (collected by the licensed accommodation). Eco-Contribution Act (Cap. 473) Second Schedule.
rows.note: Checklist item F3; detailed table: tourist-tax

source.title: Eco-Contribution Act (Cap. 473), Second Schedule, as amended up to Act III of 2026 (legislation.mt)

rows.label: Customs duties, import VAT and travel allowances (Dazju doganali) [EU]
rows.value: EU Common Customs Tariff; €3 per item on consignments up to €150 from 1 July 2026; €2 Union handling fee per item on distance sales from 1 November 2026; import VAT 18%; travellers €430. Paid by importers and travellers. EU customs legislation; Customs Ordinance (Cap. 37); Value Added Tax Act (Cap. 406).
rows.note: Checklist item G1; detailed table: customs

source.title: MTCA (Customs): New €3 Duty on Imports of Non-EU Goods in Consignments valued at €150 or less

rows.label: Stamp duties on documents: transfers of marketable securities and other documents (Taxxa tal-boll fuq dokumenti) [national]
rows.value: 2% on transfers of marketable securities (shares); 5% on documents transferring immovable property; insurance policy duty. Paid by transferees and parties to the document. Duty on Documents and Transfers Act (Cap. 364).

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Malta: complete list
rows.note: Checklist item A5; detailed table: capital-gains
rows.source_title: Income Tax Act (Cap. 123), consolidated text as amended up to Act III of 2026 (legislation.mt)
rows.label: Capital gains: final tax on transfers of Malta immovable property (Taxxa fuq it-trasferiment ta' proprjetà immobbli) [national]
rows.value: 8% of the transfer value (10% for some group transfers of property acquired before 2004; 12% of the gain on property inherited or donated more than five years earlier). Paid by the seller. Income Tax Act (Cap. 123) art. 5A.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Malta: complete list
rows.note: Checklist item A6; detailed table: distributed-profits
rows.source_title: Income Tax Act (Cap. 123), consolidated text as amended up to Act III of 2026 (legislation.mt)
rows.label: Withholding on dividends, interest and other investment income (Taxxa finali fuq id-dħul minn investimenti) [national]
rows.value: 15% final tax on investment income such as interest where the recipient opts for it; 15% on dividends paid out of the untaxed account; dividends out of taxed profits carry the company's 35% tax (imputation). Paid by recipients (withheld by the paying company or financial intermediary). Income Tax Act (Cap. 123) art. 41 and 62.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Malta: complete list
rows.note: Checklist item A7
rows.source_title: MTCA: Tax on Rental Income (TA24)
rows.label: Rental income and pension income (Dħul minn kera u pensjonijiet) [national]
rows.value: landlords may opt for a final tax of 15% on gross rental income (Income Tax Act art. 31D; form TA24); qualifying pension income of individuals aged 61 or over exempt from 2026. Paid by landlords and pensioners. Income Tax Act (Cap. 123); Rental income rules.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Malta: complete list
rows.note: Checklist item B2; detailed table: social-employer
rows.source_title: Department of Social Security: Social Security Contributions (Class 1) 2026 – Employed Persons (Maternity Leave Fund column)
rows.label: Employer levies: Maternity Leave Fund (Fond għall-Leave tal-Maternità) [national]
rows.value: 0.3% of the basic weekly wage (category C; fixed weekly amounts in the other categories). Paid by employers. Social Security Act (Cap. 318).

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Malta: complete list
rows.note: Checklist item B3b; detailed table: contractor-rules
rows.source_title: Employment Status National Standard Order (S.L. 452.108, Legal Notice 44 of 2012 as amended) (legislation.mt)
rows.label: Contractor rules: Employment Status National Standard (employee or self-employed test) (Standard Nazzjonali dwar l-Istatus tal-Impjieg) [national]
rows.value: employment presumed where at least five of eight criteria are met (e.g. 75% of income from one client, client's tools, working schedule, no substitution). Paid by service users (employer obligations where the presumption applies). Employment Status National Standard Order (S.L. 452.108).

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Malta: complete list
rows.note: Checklist item C1; detailed table: corporate-tax
rows.source_title: Malta Tax and Customs Administration (MTCA): Corporate Tax
rows.label: Corporate income tax (Taxxa fuq il-kumpaniji) [national]
rows.value: 35% with shareholder refunds of part or all of the tax on distribution (imputation system). Paid by companies resident in Malta (worldwide income) and foreign companies on income arising in Malta. Income Tax Act (Cap. 123) art. 56(6).

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Malta: complete list
rows.note: Checklist item C3; detailed table: freelancers
rows.source_title: MTCA: Self-Employed (TA22), part-time self-employment
rows.label: Simplified regime: 10% final tax on part-time self-employment (Taxxa ta' 10% fuq xogħol part-time għal rasu) [national]
rows.value: 10% of net profit up to €12,000 a year (maximum €1,200); VAT small-enterprise exemption in the VAT section. Paid by full-time employees, pensioners and full-time students with part-time self-employment. Income Tax Act (Cap. 123) and the part-time self-employment rules.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Malta: complete list
rows.note: Checklist item C4; detailed table: distributed-profits
rows.source_title: Income Tax Act (Cap. 123), consolidated text as amended up to Act III of 2026 (legislation.mt)
rows.label: Tax on distributed profits: imputation and the untaxed account (Taxxa fuq dividendi) [national]
rows.value: no branch profits tax; 15% withheld on dividends paid out of the untaxed account. Paid by companies distributing untaxed profits (withheld from the dividend). Income Tax Act (Cap. 123) art. 62.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Malta: complete list
rows.note: Checklist item D1; detailed table: vat-rates
rows.source_title: Value Added Tax Act (Cap. 406), article 19 and Eighth Schedule (legislation.mt)
rows.label: Value added tax (Taxxa fuq il-Valur Miżjud (VAT)) [national]
rows.value: 18% standard (also on imports); 12%, 7% and 5% for supplies in the Eighth Schedule. Paid by consumers (charged by registered businesses). Value Added Tax Act (Cap. 406) art. 19 and Eighth Schedule.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Malta: complete list
rows.note: Checklist item D3; detailed table: excise
rows.source_title: Excise Duty Act (Cap. 382), First Schedule, as amended up to Act III of 2026 and Legal Notice 38 of 2026 (legislation.mt)
rows.label: Excise duties on fuel, alcohol, tobacco and other goods (Dazju tas-sisa) [national]
rows.value: e.g. unleaded petrol €359 and gas oil €330 per 1,000 litres; cigarettes 23.4% of retail price plus €107 per 1,000 (minimum €165). Paid by producers, importers and authorised warehouse keepers (passed on to consumers). Excise Duty Act (Cap. 382) First Schedule.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Malta: complete list
rows.note: Checklist item D4; detailed table: stamp-duties
rows.source_title: Duty on Documents and Transfers Act (Cap. 364), consolidated text as amended up to Act XXX of 2025 (legislation.mt)
rows.label: Duty on insurance policies (insurance premium duty) (Taxxa fuq polza tal-assigurazzjoni) [national]
rows.value: 11 cents per euro of the yearly premium on most policies (minimum €13); 10 cents per euro on life policies (minimum €11.65); none on aviation, marine, credit and suretyship policies. Paid by policyholders (collected by insurers). Duty on Documents and Transfers Act (Cap. 364) art. 25A and 27.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Malta: complete list
rows.note: Checklist item E2; detailed table: stamp-duty-property
rows.source_title: Duty on Documents and Transfers Act (Cap. 364), consolidated text as amended up to Act XXX of 2025 (legislation.mt)
rows.label: Property transfer duty (duty on documents and transfers) (Taxxa tal-boll fuq trasferimenti ta' proprjetà) [national]
rows.value: 5% of the price or value, whichever is higher; 3.5% on the first €200,000 for a sole ordinary residence; 1% provisional duty on the promise of sale. Paid by the buyer. Duty on Documents and Transfers Act (Cap. 364) art. 32.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Malta: complete list
rows.note: Checklist item E4; detailed table: inheritance
rows.source_title: MTCA: FAQs Causa Mortis
rows.label: Duty on inheritance of immovable property (causa mortis) (Taxxa causa mortis) [national]
rows.value: 5% of the value (3.5% on the first €150,000 where the heir lives in the property); surviving spouse's share of the residence and children inheriting the parents' residence exempt. Paid by heirs of immovable property in Malta. Duty on Documents and Transfers Act (Cap. 364) art. 32 to 35.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Malta: complete list
rows.note: Checklist item F1
rows.source_title: Motor Vehicles Registration and Licensing Act (Cap. 368), as amended up to Act III of 2026 (legislation.mt)
rows.label: Motor vehicle registration tax and annual circulation fee (Taxxa tar-reġistrazzjoni u liċenzja annwali tal-vetturi) [national]
rows.value: registration tax and annual circulation licence fee by vehicle category, CO2 emissions and value (amounts not stored). Paid by vehicle owners. Motor Vehicles Registration and Licensing Act (Cap. 368) First and Fourth Schedules.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Malta: complete list
rows.note: Checklist item F3; detailed table: tourist-tax
rows.source_title: Eco-Contribution Act (Cap. 473), Second Schedule, as amended up to Act III of 2026 (legislation.mt)
rows.label: Eco-contribution on tourist accommodation (Eko-kontribuzzjoni fuq l-akkomodazzjoni) [national]
rows.value: €1.50 per night per person, at most €22.50 per visit. Paid by guests aged 18 or over (collected by the licensed accommodation). Eco-Contribution Act (Cap. 473) Second Schedule.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Malta: complete list
rows.note: Checklist item G1; detailed table: customs
rows.source_title: MTCA (Customs): New €3 Duty on Imports of Non-EU Goods in Consignments valued at €150 or less
rows.label: Customs duties, import VAT and travel allowances (Dazju doganali) [EU]
rows.value: EU Common Customs Tariff; €3 per item on consignments up to €150 from 1 July 2026; €2 Union handling fee per item on distance sales from 1 November 2026; import VAT 18%; travellers €430. Paid by importers and travellers. EU customs legislation; Customs Ordinance (Cap. 37); Value Added Tax Act (Cap. 406).

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Malta: complete list
rows.note: Checklist item H1; detailed table: stamp-duties
rows.source_title: Duty on Documents and Transfers Act (Cap. 364), consolidated text as amended up to Act XXX of 2025 (legislation.mt)
rows.label: Stamp duties on documents: transfers of marketable securities and other documents (Taxxa tal-boll fuq dokumenti) [national]
rows.value: 2% on transfers of marketable securities (shares); 5% on documents transferring immovable property; insurance policy duty. Paid by transferees and parties to the document. Duty on Documents and Transfers Act (Cap. 364).

rows.value: None: income tax is charged under the Income Tax Act at the rates of that Act; no surcharge, solidarity, health or defence levy on income tax is among the revenue acts administered by the Commissioner for Tax and Customs. Paid by no one. Commissioner for Tax and Customs Act (Cap. 517), art. 2.

rows.value: None: local and regional councils are financed by an annual government allocation under the Appropriation Act; the power to raise their own funds (art. 60) was deleted in 2019. Paid by no one. Local Government Act (Cap. 363), arts. 55 and 60.

rows.label: Occupational pension: no mandatory scheme (voluntary occupational pension schemes with tax credits) [national]
rows.value: None compulsory: occupational retirement schemes are set up on a voluntary basis; tax credit of 25% of qualifying contributions, at most €750 a year per employee for the employer and €750 for the employee (from 2017). Paid by no one (voluntary contributions by employers and employees). Voluntary Occupational Pension Scheme Rules (S.L. 123.175), rules 2, 5 and 6.

rows.label: Local business tax: none [national]
rows.value: None: local councils levy no business tax; they are financed by the annual government allocation (the article on raising additional funds was deleted in 2019). Paid by no one. Local Government Act (Cap. 363), arts. 55 and 60.

rows.source_title: Legislation Malta: Local Government Act (Cap. 363), Part VI Finance, articles 55 to 60, point in time 22 December 2023
rows.label: Regional or municipal sales tax: none [national]
rows.value: None: VAT and excise duties are national; local and regional councils are financed by the annual government allocation. Paid by no one. Local Government Act (Cap. 363), arts. 55 and 60.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Malta: complete list

rows.label: Excise duty on mobile telephony services and electricity (dazju tas-sisa fuq it-telefonija mobbli u l-elettriku) [national]
rows.value: Mobile telephony services (line rental and top-up vouchers) 4%; electricity €1.50 per MWh; natural gas €0.84 per gigajoule for heating, €2.60 as motor fuel, 0 for power generation. Paid by mobile operators and energy suppliers, passed on to consumers. Excise Duty Act (Cap. 382), schedules on energy products and mobile telephony services.

rows.label: Property tax: none (no annual tax on owning property) [national]
rows.value: None: no annual tax on land or buildings is among the revenue acts; property is taxed only on transfer (duty on documents and transfers, item E2, and the final tax on transfers, item A5); local councils levy no taxes. Paid by no one. Commissioner for Tax and Customs Act (Cap. 517), art. 2.

rows.label: Wealth tax: none [national]

rows.value: None: the First Schedule (eco-contribution on products) was deleted by Act XVI of 2017; only the eco-contribution on accommodation remains (item F3); no carbon tax is among the revenue acts. Paid by no one. Eco-Contribution Act (Cap. 473), art. 3 and First Schedule.
